correctness.rationale: For four goods under strictly positive additive valuations, EFX forces all three agents nonempty and hence a doubleton plus two singletons. Testing the resulting 36 allocations by the exact singleton-versus-doubleton criterion gives 14 EFX allocations. The complete independent-allocation dominance comparison against all 81 possible allocations leaves five EFX+PO cases. On these five the envy surplus rows for (1,2),(1,3),(3,2) are (0,0,3,-1,-1),(1,1,-2,-1,-1),(-3,-3,5,3,3), respectively. Nonnegative expectation forces 3d_13+d_32=-p_R>=0 and hence p_R=0; d_12 then forces p_S+p_T=0; d_32 finally forces p_P+p_Q=0, contradicting normalized probability. The verified common bi-valued existence theorem of Bu et al. supplies the positive side. Full exact code and terminal output included.

originality.rationale: The new exact claim concerns the smallest globally shared cardinality of singleton-value levels causing failure of the combined ex-ante EF, ex-post EFX and ex-post integral PO existence guarantee. The source Aziz 2026 Theorem 5 covers the coarser three-agent/four-good impossibility, but its actual exhibited instance uses five global levels; it does not state the three-level sharpness. Bu et al. prove that a common two-level alphabet cannot yield a counterexample. Other examined work gives generic duality and different valuation-class examples. Direct semantic and text searches for tri-valued additive boundaries and equivalent formulations identified no covering result; unobserved priority remains possible.

value.rationale: The minimal number of globally shared singleton utility levels is a natural complexity parameter in the bi-valued fair-division literature. The exact boundary—unconditional EF+EFX+fPO existence for two levels versus a strictly positive three-level EFX+integral-PO obstruction—pins down a qualitative transition at the smallest possible complexity increase. Unlike rescaling or merely reducing a random matrix, it closes the alphabet-cardinality question at the point between the precise published positive and negative results and supplies a human-checkable tiny dual certificate. The paper’s broad 3x4 impossibility is not republished as the novelty.
